about: The pipeline stages, in order. One source for the runner (atlas_web/runner.py), run_demo.sh, the API (/api/stages) and the UI (atlas_web/static/js/stages.js is generated from this file: python -m contracts.stages --write-js). `id` is the code/API name; `label` is the UI name; `plain` is the one-line plain-language description; `steps` are the CLI steps the stage runs, in order.

stages.label: Detect
stages.plain: Find encryption a future quantum computer could break (RSA, ECC)

stages.label: Proof Chain
stages.plain: Start the signed record: the Detect evidence is signed (ML-DSA-65) before anything else runs

stages.label: Plan
stages.plain: Schedule the migration in weekly waves (MILP, QpiAI Opt local)

stages.label: Handshakes
stages.plain: Record real TLS 1.3 handshakes from the lab services

stages.label: Gates
stages.plain: Check each wave: post-quantum handshake, downgrade refused, compatibility, rollback

stages.label: QAOA
stages.plain: Cross-check one link cutover window with QAOA on a simulator against the exact optimum

stages.label: Seal
stages.plain: Add every result to the Proof Chain and verify every signature and hash

stages.label: Report
stages.plain: Assemble, validate and sign the report

about_flow: The seven user-facing pipeline steps (mentor flow), in order, for navigation and the overview. `route` is the page; `stages` are the execution stages above that produce its data. Execution order differs only where noted: the Proof Chain opens right after Detect and is sealed at the end.

flow.label: Detect
flow.does: Finds RSA and elliptic-curve crypto in code, configs, certificates and live TLS connections.

flow.label: Inventory & drift
flow.does: Groups findings into systems to migrate and flags where a live connection differs from the config.
flow.hands: The inventory of systems to migrate

flow.label: Schedule
flow.does: Plans the migration in weekly waves that cut exposure fastest, within team capacity and dependencies.

flow.label: Wave selection
flow.does: Cross-checks one week's choice of systems with QAOA on a simulator against the exact answer.

flow.label: Handshake gates
flow.does: Tests every wave on real TLS 1.3 lab services: post-quantum handshake, no downgrade, compatibility, rollback.

flow.label: Ledger
flow.does: Signs every result into a tamper-evident Proof Chain (ML-DSA-65) and verifies it.

flow.label: Review
flow.does: A person approves or rejects each result with a reason; the decision is signed too.
